description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a server manager simulation for the Rialto project. It includes functions to retrieve environment variables, configure server startup parameters, and runs a test HTTP server that handles session server management commands.

classes.name: ServerManagerConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for the server manager, encapsulating environment variables, preloaded server count, session server path, and startup timeout.

classes.name: TestService
classes.description: A test HTTP server that simulates the Rialto server management interface, allowing setting and getting application states, and other control commands.

methods.name: getSessionServerPath
methods.description: Retrieves the session server path from environment variable or defaults to '/usr/bin/RialtoServer'.

methods.name: getStartupTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves the startup timeout in milliseconds from environment variable or defaults to zero.

methods.name: getEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Parses the 'SESSION_SERVER_ENV_VARS' environment variable into a list of individual environment variable strings.

methods.name: getNumberOfPreloadedServers
methods.description: Retrieves the number of preloaded servers from environment variable or defaults to zero.
